description: Summary worker: process the next job and requeue interrupted ones.
precondition: Queued summary job; language model replaced.

preconditions: A draft is Queued; the model for the meeting sensitivity is ready.
The transcript, agenda and closed votes are readable.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the worker calls it for the oldest queued draft.
cases.return: true; the draft is stored whole with the model name and the time it was read; the vote lines come straight from the data, never through the model.
cases.log: Saved: draft content replacing the old text whole; the earlier review and correction no longer apply.

cases.inputs: No arguments; the queue is empty.
cases.return: false; nothing is claimed and nothing changes.

preconditions: A draft is Queued; another worker claims it first.
cases.inputs: No arguments; two workers race for the same draft.
cases.return: true; the other worker writes the draft, this one steps aside.
cases.note: UC-58 · Claim lost to another worker: the fake store answers 0 changed rows and leaves the draft Running, the way a second worker that claimed first would.

preconditions: A draft is Queued; the model refuses the request.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the model answers with a failure message.
cases.return: true; the draft is Failed with the model message.
cases.log: Warning logged with the meeting id and the model message.
